content.title: Investors Pile Into Bullish Bets on Bitcoin Treasury Company Strive
content.summary: Individual investors are snapping up bullish bets tied to Strive, the company co-founded by Vivek Ramaswamy and known for railing against "woke" corporate policies.  A record more than 2.5 million call options contracts tied to Strive changed hands Monday, making it one of the most actively-traded options contracts, according to Cboe Global Markets data.  The strategy has surged in popularity this year and helped send bitcoin prices to repeated records.
